original_query: Which receives lower percentage of answers, Enterprise applications "Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use" or "Take too long to get results"?

summaries.found_via_query: survey data comparing percentage of enterprise app users who say they are too complex vs. take too long to get results
summaries.summary: A bar chart from a 2014 SAP-commissioned study by Forrester Consulting shows reasons why enterprise BI applications are sometimes not used. The top reason is 'Do not have all the data you need' at 45%, followed by 'Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use' at 32%, and 'Take too long to get results' at 29%.
key_facts: 32% of respondents say enterprise applications are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use.
29% of respondents say enterprise applications take too long to get results.
The study surveyed 302 business and IT decision-makers who influence BI decisions.
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014.
visible_text: Enterprise BI: Too Little Data And Too Hard to Use
Why do you sometimes choose not to use enterprise BI applications?
Do not have all the data you need 45%
Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use 32%
Take too long to get results 29%
Base: 302 business and IT decision-makers who influence BI decisions
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014
